name: Idea to Storyboard to Video
description: Carry a pitched idea through a shot-by-shot storyboard, Firefly-generated storyboard frames, and Firefly-animated video, with a human final review before delivery.
author: hereliesaz

definitions.name: Idea to Storyboard to Video
definitions.description: Carry a pitched idea through a shot-by-shot storyboard, Firefly-generated storyboard frames, and Firefly-animated video, with a human final review before delivery.

agents.name: Storyboard Scriptwriter
agents.description: Breaks the pitched idea into a shot-by-shot storyboard script with a fixed visual style.

agents.name: Firefly Storyboard Artist
agents.description: Generates one storyboard frame per shot via Adobe Firefly from the shot list and style guide.

agents.name: Firefly Video Animator
agents.description: Animates and assembles the storyboard frames into a video via Adobe Firefly.

agents.name: Production Final Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews the assembled video against the storyboard script before approval.
